about: Bible twenty questions: hand-written tag values (design §5.3 stand-in). Written in one pass by the implementation job (sequence 30 step 19), because the two-pass model run of design §5.3-5.6 needs the owner's yes on its cost first. Per tag: yes = person -> verse ('EXO 4:3', book codes from data/catalog.json) that shows it; no / unsure = people set by hand; slip = values players often get wrong (treated as unsure in guess mode). Anyone not listed is UNSURE, except: closed 'all' = no for everyone unlisted; closed 'tier1' = no for unlisted tier-1 people (curated by hand); noEra = no for unlisted people of those eras; noMen = no for unlisted men. tq_build.py checks every verse: it must exist in the BSB and lie in the person's verse list or name them, otherwise the value drops to unsure. A tag here may also correct a data tag for named people.
